title: Talk to a person: one CS Telegram topic per customer (reopened when they ask again), staff text and photos reach that account only, the model is silent meanwhile, and the conversation survives until cleared
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://tracy:tracy@127.0.0.1:51730/postgres node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/assistant-support.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/chat.test.mjs (any Postgres whose user may create schemas; this one is the local stand's). Telegram and the artifact store are in-process fakes.

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail', '# skipped' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "a handoff opens one topic"; "while a person holds it the model is silent"; "a staff reply reaches the right account"; "only the configured chat, an open topic, and a person"; "a staff photo is kept in the store"; "Resolved returns to the AI"; "a topic deleted in Telegram is replaced"; "clearing during a handoff"; "the webhook relays only with the exact secret"; "the conversation survives the page"; "listedHref rebuilds".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0', and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 28): the database cases ran, none skipped.

Every named case is 'ok': one topic per handoff, named after the customer, whose summary holds only that customer's data; asking again reopens the same topic (reopenTopic, summary starting 'The customer asked for a person again'), and a deleted topic is replaced by a new one; the model is not called in waiting_human or human; a staff message reaches only the account bound to its (chat, topic), never from another chat, a bot, a sender_chat, a closed or unknown topic, and a redelivered message lands once; a photo is served to its own account (200 image/jpeg), 404 to another, 401 without a session; Resolved and clearing note the reason, close the topic and stop relaying; customer text queued but unsent at clear is never sent; the webhook answers 404 without the exact secret even with a valid cookie; a restore returns every turn and a stale conversation id is 409; only listed link addresses become links.

selectors.service: createSupport in apps/tracy-web/src/assistant/support.js (open, receive, drain, end, clear)
selectors.rows: assistant_conversation, assistant_handoff, assistant_outbox, assistant_turn (role staff), assistant_attachment

evidence: PR #945, 05-06/10/2026: also run by hand on the local stand with the CS bot tracy_cs_dev_bot in polling mode: topic 18 created, staff text and a photo shown in the panel with an unread badge, a PDF answered with the 'Only text and photos' note, Resolved closed the topic, and asking again reopened topic 18.
fence: A staff message is relayed only through the open handoff bound to its Telegram (chat, topic); the database state, not the model, decides who answers.

tests: while a person holds it the model is silent
a staff reply reaches the right account
only the configured chat, an open topic, and a person
a staff photo is kept in the store
a topic deleted in Telegram is replaced
the webhook relays only with the exact secret
